newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Price of a boy's life in Costa Rica - $4.
newsitem.headline: Price of a boy's life in Costa Rica - $4.

text.p: Two Costa Rican boys have confessed to murdering their 8-year-old friend to steal $4 from his pocket, police said on Tuesday.

Adolfo Briones Bustos, a young Nicaraguan immigrant who eked out a living selling fresh herbs, was found dead, floating in the Reventazon River, about 60 miles (100 km) northeast of San Jose, on Jan. 27.
Police first assumed the child had drowned, but an autopsy found he had been beaten, drowned and robbed of an 800-colon ($4) note he was carrying.
Two boys, age 7 and 13, who lived next door to Briones in the dirt-poor banana town of Siquirres, confessed to the killing under police questioning.
A suspicious shopkeeper had tipped off authorities when the normally penniless boys bought an unusually large quantity of candy.
